description: Sample resynthesiser: a loaded sample is analysed frame by frame and played back by up to 32 oscillators, each with its own start, stop and speed

params.text: Picks the waveform every oscillator uses: sine, triangle, sawtooth, square or a rectangle a quarter of a cycle wide
Sets how many oscillators are driven, 1 to 32
Multiplies the frequency of every oscillator, doubling it at +1 and quartering it at -3, without changing the playback speed
Sets how far each oscillator is pushed away from the warp centre frequency, 0 to 100%, which at 100% doubles its distance from that centre
Sets the frequency the warp pushes the oscillators away from, 0Hz to 10000Hz
Adds the frequency of the first voice to the warp centre, so the centre follows the analysed fundamental and CENTER FREQ becomes an offset from it
Adds an offset to every speed drawn on the SPEED grid, -3 to 3, where a negative speed plays that voice backward
Adds an offset to every start point drawn on the START grid, 0 to 100% of the sample
Adds an offset to every stop point drawn on the STOP grid, -100% to 0 of the sample
Sets how far the frame each voice reads jumps at random between steps, 0 to 100%, the same jump for every voice
Adds an offset to every value on the FM AMOUNT grid, 0 to 100% of its range
Adds an offset to every value on the AM/RM MIX grid, 0 to 100% of its range
Starts playback again at the stop point rather than letting it end
Makes every voice travel the same distance whether it plays forward or backward, so fewer of them fall silent, at the cost of voices stopping at different points
Chooses when the end-of-cycle pulse is sent and a loop starts again: when every voice has finished, or as soon as the first one has

inputs.text: A rising edge here starts playback, sending every voice back to its own start position
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the FM MATRIX grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the FM MATRIX drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the FM AMOUNT grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the FM AMOUNT drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
A frequency modulation source for whichever oscillators the FM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic, and 5V shifts an oscillator by 10000Hz
A second frequency modulation source for whichever oscillators the FM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic, and 5V shifts an oscillator by 10000Hz
A modulator for whichever oscillators the AM/RM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic
A second modulator for whichever oscillators the AM/RM MATRIX assigns to it; polyphonic
Adds to the voice count, 10V covering 1 to 32 oscillators
Adds to the waveform, 10V stepping across all five
Adds to the tuning, each volt moving it by 0.6 of a unit rather than by an octave, despite the tooltip naming V/Oct
Adds to the warp amount, 10V covering 0 to 100%
Adds to the warp centre frequency, 10V covering 0Hz to 10000Hz
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the AM/RM MATRIX grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the AM/RM MATRIX drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the AM/RM MIX grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the AM/RM MIX drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the randomness, 10V covering 0 to 100%
Adds an offset to every value drawn on the PANNING grid, 5V covering the whole range
Slides the PANNING drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the rotation of the PANNING grid, 5V being 180 degrees
Adds an offset to every speed on the SPEED grid, 5V covering the whole -3 to 3 range
Slides the SPEED drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the rotation of the SPEED grid, 5V being 180 degrees
Adds an offset to every start point on the START grid, 5V covering the whole sample
Slides the START drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the rotation of the START grid, 5V being 180 degrees
Adds an offset to every stop point on the STOP grid, 5V covering the whole sample
Slides the STOP drawing across the voices, 5V covering the whole height of the grid
Adds to the rotation of the STOP grid, 5V being 180 degrees
A trigger here turns looping on and off

outputs.text: The left channel of the resynthesis, carrying the whole unpanned mix while the right output is unpatched
The right channel of the resynthesis
A 10V pulse when playback reaches the end that the EOC MODE button selects

notes: the module does nothing until a WAV file is read in with Load Sample from its own right-click menu; with no file loaded the analysis is skipped and the outputs stay at 0V
a grid is drawn on by dragging across it, and holding shift while dragging keeps the drag on the band it started on, so one band can be set without disturbing its neighbours
each grid is one display rather than one control per band, so no band can be clicked for a line of its own
right-clicking a grid opens that grid's own menu rather than the module's, and All Maximum, All Minimum, All Half, Triangle, Sine, Ramp and Random fill the grid with that shape
a grid's own right-click menu also carries Flip Horizontal, Flip Vertical, Reduce By Half, Shift Left and Shift Right, which rework what is already drawn on it
menu: Load Sample — chooses the WAV file that is analysed and resynthesised
Window Function — picks the shape each frame is multiplied by, which changes the harmonic content of the result: None, Triangle, Welch, Sine, Hanning, Blackman, Nutall or Kaiser
